items.name: test-no-emoji
items.title: Gate: No Emoji
items.description: Turns the platform's no-emoji rule into a failing test that names every offending file:line. Roots and deliberate exceptions live in docs/gates.json, so the test file stays identical in every repo. Installing it into an existing app is a MIGRATION, not a copy — it lands red on whatever drift is already there.

items.name: test-ci-hardening
items.title: Gate: CI Hardening
items.description: Four GitHub Actions hardening rules as a failing test that names every offending file:line — top-level permissions, third-party actions pinned to a full commit SHA (the tj-actions CVE-2025-30066 class), no pull_request_target, and no attacker-controlled context interpolated into a run: block. Trusted owners and strict mode live in docs/gates.json. Measured before it existed: 0 of 8 workflows on this platform declared top-level permissions and 0 pinned any action by SHA.
